_comment: Reference copy of the runtime configuration in src/config/Config.jsx.
ExtendScript cannot read JSON without JSON.parse, so the script itself always
uses src/config/Config.jsx. This file exists for humans, for tooling and for a
future Python/COM layer that wants to read or write the same defaults.
When you change a value here, change it in Config.jsx as well.
